scripts.dev: npm run build -w @inkmate/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @inkmate/server" "npm run dev -w @inkmate/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @inkmate/shared && npm run build -w @inkmate/web && npm run build -w @inkmate/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @inkmate/shared && npm run typecheck -w @inkmate/shared && npm run typecheck -w @inkmate/server && npm run typecheck -w @inkmate/web
